author: Brian Hawken
text: the region is the country you bought it in.  the apps/sensors are country specific as are the readers.  if you bought the sensor in Country A and download the app on a phone in Country B they will not be compatible.  Same with readers, if you buy the sensor in Country A then also need to have bought the reader in Country A.  There are workarounds involving changing the apple store country (or google play store) but that is above my paygrade to explain.  Good luck.
